package.name: inspire_hand_description
package.description:
URDF/xacro description and meshes for the Inspire Robotics RH56 dexterous hand, in both left and right variants.
Vendored and transformed from the upstream dex-urdf model; see MODEL_PROVENANCE.md. The ros2_control block here is for simulation only - the real hand is driven by inspire_hand_driver over RS485.
